caseStudies.title: LandWatch: Statutory Delay & Risk Engine
caseStudies.subtitle: Smart India Hackathon 2026 Project Pipeline
caseStudies.description: A deep architectural walkthrough of how LandWatch converts chaotic municipal legal records into audited mathematical delay predictions.

steps.title: Problem Context
steps.description: Infrastructure & commercial development projects in India face an average of 14-26 months of statutory delay due to disjoint municipal, environmental, and litigation clearances.

steps.title: Civic Data ETL Pipeline
steps.description: Automated ingestion parsers aggregate GIS shapefiles, high court litigation registries, state RERA statutory disclosures, and forest clearance statuses into a unified PostgreSQL/Vector database.

steps.title: XGBoost Machine Learning
steps.description: Trained gradient boosted decision trees with custom loss penalties evaluating statutory risk scores, project size, regional clearance velocity, and litigation volatility.

steps.title: SHAP Explainability Kernel
steps.description: Calculates Shapley additive values for every feature. Rather than a black box, each predicted delay outputs a transparent factor waterfall showing exactly why risks were scored high.

steps.title: Interactive Risk HUD
steps.description: Civic officers and project managers view dynamic spatial heatmaps, statutory delay projections, and judicial mitigation recommendations in real time.

caseStudies.title: Quantum Grid Optimization Engine
caseStudies.subtitle: QUBO & QAOA Microgrid Simulation
caseStudies.description: Bridging quantum computing and sustainable energy by formulating renewable storage dispatch as an Ising Hamiltonian solved via hybrid variational circuits.

steps.title: Renewable Input Telemetry
steps.description: Solar irradiance, wind velocity forecasts, variable consumer load curves, and battery storage state-of-charge are ingested on 15-minute operational dispatch intervals.

steps.title: Binary Mapping to QUBO
steps.description: Discrete generator dispatch decisions and charge/discharge states are mapped into binary variables {0, 1} with quadratic penalty terms for grid imbalances.

steps.title: Ising Hamiltonian Synthesis
steps.description: Variables are translated into Pauli-Z spin operators (σz) constructing the problem Hamiltonian HC whose ground state represents the lowest-cost emission dispatch.

steps.title: QAOA Variational Circuit
steps.description: Parameterized single-qubit rotations and entangling CNOT gates alternate across p-layers, optimized classically via COBYLA feedback loops to find optimal gamma (γ) and beta (β) angles.

steps.title: Optimal Grid Dispatch
steps.description: High-probability quantum bitstrings decode directly into physical power dispatch orders, achieving 18.4% grid loss reduction while guaranteeing storage lifespan.
